summary: The prepared base reproduces the reported retile rank-mismatch abort. Exact candidate 0d04a0606079e3dce8bad3e888db4c28bac9d05b fixes the original 64x64 GPU case and minimum/larger tile boundaries on gfx950.

tests.what_was_measured: Base native compiler abort in intTupleZip2ByImpl with the reported mismatched-ranks assertion.

Candidate GPU atomic sums versus independent CPU float64 references; maximum absolute error 1.7599101e-05. LLVM/ISA dumps show 16 atomicrmw fadd and 16 gfx950 global_atomic_cmpswap instructions for 64x64.
Candidate regression: 2 passed, including retiled execution and focused no-retile diagnostic.

gpu_evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 executed the numerical kernels; generated ISA declares amdgcn-amd-amdhsa-unknown-gfx950 and contains global atomic compare-swap instructions.
remaining_limitations: The reported MI308X was unavailable, so that exact architecture remains unverified.
The candidate regression tolerance is looser than the independently observed numerical errors.
